validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false"/>
    <data id="user" expr="({name:'bob'})"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <invoke type="http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/" src="child.scxml"><finalize><raise event="x"/></finalize></invoke>
    <transition event="done.invoke" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<raise>` inside `<finalize>` raises an event, which `<finalize>` must not do
notes: `<finalize>` runs while an event returned by the invoked service is being processed, before transitions are selected, to update the data model from `_event`; SCXML forbids it to raise events or invoke external actions, naming `<send>` and `<raise>` explicitly
diagnostics.help: keep only data-model updates (`<assign>`, `<log>`, `<if>`, `<foreach>`) in `<finalize>`; to react to the returned event, move the `<raise>` into a `<transition>` that matches it
